description: the man of the reference picture riding: a radiant demigod of victory, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, eyes glowing gold, a crown of golden sun rays on the bare head, white marble and gold plate armour with a golden lion's head on the breastplate, a sapphire blue skirt with golden trim, two small wings of golden light folded close behind the shoulders, a long sapphire blue cape with small golden stars hanging behind from the shoulders, white and gold greaves and boots, no sword, no shield and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the folded wings, the cloak and any long hair close behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the crown's sun rays to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, beard, crown of sun rays, wings of light, armour, cape and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the sword and the shield
